name: BEAKER
summary: Evaluates multimodal models as the embodied brain of a self-driving chemistry lab on expert-written image and video questions, from affordance grounding and trajectory planning to apparatus, state and safety recognition and procedure reasoning.
numbers: 1,000 QA, 11 task types incl. 60 safety questions; 28 models; weakest on affordance grounding, trajectories and safety norms

why.cog: Expert chemistry knowledge and procedure reasoning.
